verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Rootly serves an llms.txt at docs.rootly.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200, with a product summary), and its docs pages are served as raw markdown (.md URLs), so an agent can ingest them directly. Agent-oriented MCP server documentation is also published. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or a full-content export, no first-party docs explaining agent consumption of llms.txt, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using it.
